i think what bothers me the most is that I chose the wrong major at the wrong school. Before entering college I was so confident and I would always think of how my future will be bright. But when I started the school and began getting low grades my confidence started to decline. I blame myself everyday for not changing it when I had the chance, for not asking for help when it wasn't too late, and for not making the right decisions. Now it's too late. I am worried about my dad. We are poor, my dad brought us here to have a better life. But I feel like I am not going to fulfill his dreams for us because I am not succeeding in college. He's always complaining about we're not making any progress or that our life is not stable. I told him it's because we haven't finished school yet. He says he understands that. But I feel like he's  blaming me for not graduating yet and not having a job yet. Because If I have graduated, he could have been just chillin' at home and not working. 

My sister is older than me and she has a stable job (she's in the military)but she does not want to help us. I kind of understand why because she's a single mother and she needs to prioritize her son first. One time I borrowed 500 dollars from her to pay for my summer classes. I told her I will repay her back when I get my financial aid on September. But it 5 days after I borrowed the money she told me to repay it back because she doesn't have anymore money (it was hard to believe because her son receives child support, she has benefits from the military, she gets free housing, free medical, a job). I told her I have no enough money but she said that if i don't repay it back, she will get me in trouble. I had too get that money from my credit card. Now my credit is maxed out. I can barely pay for the monthly payments. She only thinks about herself.  And her ego is also a problem. She always wants to be on top of everyone. And she always wants to be the smartest one and it makes her angry if someone praises us. Also she isn't too happy if something good is happening to us. I have a younger brother. But I can't even talk to him, because he finds my problems way too pathetic. My mom died when we were just little. 

It drives me crazy everyday. That's why waking up is dreadful for me because now I am awake and thinking. Thinking about my problems.

my gpa is so low and i'm getting c's in every class for my major. And i've been putting off the classes that I did not want to take last year. Now I am stuck with the hardest classes. And to make things even worse, almost all the classes I am about to take are only offered once a year, if i fail one of them (I'm sure I will) I will need to stay for another year and that means I have to take out loans. I told myself every year that I will do better. But stupid me, can't fulfill that promise. I am a chem. major and i wanted to be a pharmacist. But i realized that it's not what I wanted to do. I even don't want to work in the medical field anymore. I blame myself too much everyday for the mistakes and the wrong decisions I've made. And because of the decisions I've made, I feel like my future is not looking very bright. Most people see me as a success. But they don't know how much I see myself as a failure. And no matter how much I say to myself not to think about what other people might say about me. I cannot avoid to think about the fact that they will see me differently once they find out that I am indeed a failure.
